stem:
Consider the following statements :
1. The Barren Island volcano is an active volcano located in the Indian territory.
2. Barren Island lies about 140 km east of Great Nicobar.
3. The last time the Barren Island Volcano erupted was in 1991 and it has remained inactive since then.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
expl: The Barren island is an island located in Andaman Sea, dominated by Barren Volcano, the only confirmed active volcano in South Asia. It is a part of the Indian Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Hence statement 1 is correct. It lies about 135 km, northeast of the Union Territory's capital Port Blair (Now Sri Vijaya Puram) and about 540 km from Great Nicobar. Hence statement 2 is incorrect. The volcano erupted for the first time (as per the records) in 1787. In 1991 there was another eruption that lasted for about six months and was particularly harmful to island's fauna. However there were eruptions in 1994-95 and 2005-06, the latter considered to be linked to the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake. Hence statement 3 is incorrect.
The Barren Island is located in the Andaman Sea in the Bay of Bengal, about 135 km northeast of Port Blair. It is the only active volcano in South Asia. It first erupted (recorded) in 1787.

stem: The two volcanic Islands in the Indian Territory are -
expl: • India has only two volcanic islands—Barren Island and Narcondam Island. • Both are located in the Andaman Sea, in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands group, and are of volcanic origin. • Barren Island is India’s only active volcano, where eruptions have been recorded many times. • Narcondam Island is also of volcanic origin, but at present it is considered an inactive/dormant volcano.

stem: Which of the following is geographically closest to Great Nicobar?
expl: Great Nicobar is the southernmost island of India located between 6o45' N - 7o15' N and 93o37' E - 93o56' E. This is approximately 540 km away from Port Blair, the Indonesian island of Sumatra is geographically closest to Great Nicobar as compared to Borneo, Java and Sri Lanka. Java is an island of Indonesia to the south of Sumatra. Borneo is located to the east of Sumatra.
